rawAnswer: {"story":{"what":"The change removes two places in TypeCollector that read DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0]. That list is empty for members loaded from metadata, so indexing it threw. The BothStringAndIntKeyAreNull diagnostic now gets its location from a new helper, GetPropertyIdentifierLocation, which returns null when the property has no source syntax. The field-level MemberNeedsKey diagnostic now uses FirstOrDefault. The analyzer's report callback is also wrapped so that it drops any diagnostic whose location is not in a syntax tree of the current compilation. Three new tests compile a generic struct or record struct into a metadata-only reference and check that the analyzer and generator emit no diagnostics and that the resolver is generated.
